newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX ends bourse at record closing high.
newsitem.headline: German DAX ends bourse at record closing high.

text.p: 1246 GMT - Germany's DAX index ends bourse trade nearly one percentage point higher, just off earlier record highs, boosted by a rebound in the dollar to over 1.68 marks. The dollar fell briefly after Buba said earlier there was no substance to report German officials wanted the dollar above 1.70 marks.
* DAX-30 index ends at 3,216.14 points, up 28.56. DAX hits all-time high of 3,228.58 points during the session.
* Dollar-influenced chemical stocks-BASF, Hoechst, Bayer, Hoechst -- strongly ahead.
* Banks -- Commerzbank, Deutsche, to some extent Dresdner -- favoured amid sectoral rotation.
